dialogues.speaker: Pelageya
dialogues.text: Whew... that's a relief. They think I'm way too shy, so they set up this stall for me to work on it, hoping I'll stop being afraid of talking to strangers.

dialogues.speaker: Pelageya
dialogues.text: But I feel like I'm getting a little bit better... When the first customer approached, I just left the booth behind and ran away.

dialogues.speaker: Pelageya
dialogues.text: ...Thanks to you stopping by to talk with me, I didn't have to stand here all by myself. It would have been so embarrassing.

dialogues.speaker: Pelageya
dialogues.text: I guess I still have to learn how to make the first move and talk to strangers... *sigh* It's so tough...
